svg.title: G09 Connect the coils
svg.text: G09 Connect the coils: each phase = 15 coils in a row
Look at the stator from the REAR (connection side). Tooth 1 is at 12 o'clock at the carrier mark.
+ coil: current goes in at S. − coil: in at F.
So: F1 joins F2, S2 joins S3, F3 goes on to tooth 10.
Phase A = U (brown), starts at tooth 1
Phase B = V (black), starts at tooth 7
Phase C = W (grey), starts at tooth 4
Long jumpers between groups run on the
glass-epoxy connection ring, one track per phase.
The 3 phase ends meet in the star point.
Then check polarity with a compass (5.10).
